objective: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Lashtail Raptors.

description: Now let's step up the challenge and see if you're up to it.  Venture into the jungle and bag yourself 10 of those bloody Lashtail Raptors.  Let's see what you've got!
progress: A true hunter sets his focus on his prey. You, my friend, seem more concerned with chit-chatting around the campfire. Now get out there and kill 10 Lashtails before I go and rid the entire bloody jungle of them in one hunt.
completion: Now that's how you get a trophy or two over the ol' hearth!  Nice killing, <name>!
